//: PINS COPIED FROM demo/deno.json (module identity), covering what this
harness resolves. Two tiers, and the difference matters:
* the device-store CORE modules import no package at all
(runtime/README.md's resolution model — the EMBEDDER maps the bare
specifiers), and check under any config;
* the WORKER HOST does not, and cannot: device-store/worker.ts
imports ../../engine.ts (the polyengine embedder, the ports, the
wasi batteries) because hosting a device means instantiating the
engine. So this file now carries the demo's FULL pin set rather
than just filesystem-web, and for the demo's own module-identity
reason: the worker must get the SAME @polyengine/runtime the demo
ships, or `isComponentException` stops recognizing the engine's
err arms inside the worker and every WIT error degrades to an
unbranded throw — which is exactly the fault the RPC envelope is
built to report accurately.
@polymorph/webrtc-datachannels stays on the sibling checkout for the
reason demo/deno.json documents at length (the JSR copy defeats
`deno bundle --external`, leaving eager `node:` imports the browser
cannot fetch). This file sits three directories below the repo root
(runtime/tests/devstore), and a relative import-map entry resolves
against THIS file, so the sibling checkout is four `..` away — two
more than demo/deno.json's.
Any bump in demo/deno.json must be mirrored here or this harness
stops measuring the engine the demo ships.
